response.cypher:
MATCH (u:User {userId: $user_id})-[r1:RATED]->(shared:Movie)
      <-[r2:RATED]-(other:User)
WHERE other <> u
  AND r1.rating >= 4
  AND r2.rating >= 4

WITH u, other, count(shared) AS sharedLikes
WHERE sharedLikes >= 3
ORDER BY sharedLikes DESC, other.userId ASC
LIMIT 20

MATCH (other)-[r:RATED]->(candidate:Movie)
WHERE r.rating >= 4
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (u)-[:RATED]->(candidate)
  }

WITH candidate,
     count(other) AS supportingUsers,
     avg(r.rating) AS averageRating,
     sum(sharedLikes) AS score

RETURN candidate.movieId AS movieId,
       candidate.title AS title,
       supportingUsers,
       round(averageRating, 2) AS averageRating,
       score
ORDER BY score DESC, supportingUsers DESC, movieId ASC
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (source:Movie {movieId: $movie_id})
      -[link:SIMILAR_TO]->(candidate:Movie)

RETURN candidate.movieId AS movieId,
       candidate.title AS title,
       COUNT {
           (source)<-[first:RATED]-(u:User)
           -[second:RATED]->(candidate)
           WHERE first.rating >= 4
             AND second.rating >= 4
       } AS commonLikers,
       round(link.score, 4) AS similarity
ORDER BY similarity DESC, commonLikers DESC, movieId ASC
LIMIT $limit
